comment: Defaults equal the shipped decision_gate.pkl thresholds. Calibrate with: .venv/Scripts/python tools/evaluate_model.py --calibrate (writes measured tau_low/tau_high here without touching model weights). Backend applies these to the DecisionGate at startup; evaluation uses them with --thresholds.

evaluation.method: grid search maximizing accuracy with UNCERTAIN counted as incorrect; EER/AUC are threshold-independent and reported separately
evaluation.note: Results from a small local sample set are NOT a general benchmark.
evaluation.source: none yet -- defaults from shipped checkpoint
